Perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA), a highly persistent and toxic per- and polyfluoroalkyl substance (PFAS), poses significant environmental and health risks. Microbial degradation offers a promising remediation strategy but is limited by the scarcity and low efficiency of known degraders. Here, two PFOA-degrading strains, Alcaligenes sp. MT1 and Pseudomonas sp. MT3, were isolated and characterized. Whole-genome analysis…
